field.teacher_gate: bool independently qualified teacher-HF support; HF4code consistency and clean-realA-HF protection; RGB differences remain diagnostic

arms.seed_readiness: finite bounded nonzero encoding, pure-outside protection and unchanged base; faithful source transfer gate remains recorded FAIL

reader_rules.average: qualified GH31x31 physical tangent covariance -> exact fixed sparse K -> derived ci -> actual native GS; no new geometry or colors per frame
reader_rules.pixel: same world field sampled at true fixed G_s ray intersections with pixel-footprint antialiasing, then accumulated with the same native road/joint eligible weights
reader_rules.W_source: actual preclamp native alpha*T via eligible RGB3 + unitW feature channels, same scene rows, masks and depth sorting
reader_rules.not_allowed: whole-road-alpha overlay, PNG compositing, fitted substitute road plane, changing readonly Gaussian color contributions, or claiming road alpha is joint visibility
reader_rules.pixel_footprint: uncapped per-axis nx,ny adaptive pixel-box quadrature using actual canonical G_s UV derivatives; full5 compiled6,093,288 samples, density2, no full Gaussian Sigma
reader_rules.persistence: pixel mode saves authoritative world field plus renderer mode/geometry/scope; per-view W caches are derived, not a replacement for the world asset
reader_rules.static_lowering: given fixed geometry/valid/mH, material reads exactly factor B+KL*L+KH*H; KL/B shared across permission arms, KH includes separately interpolated mH; CPU forward and gradients checked
reader_rules.nonmaterial_fallback: 7 of16904 real-A pixels have zero common source mass, retain original eligible-ci contribution; report fullA16904 and qualifiedA16897, no loss denominator shrinking. C/S/fullS source-mass0 pixels=0
reader_rules.row_identity: average cache row_ids are global full-topology world rows and must map to active positions; pixel cache row_ids are camera-local flattened pixels, may be grouped/permuted and must scatter, never reshape directly

loss.photo_space: premult sRGB P versus fixed alpha * frozen teacher RGB; no P/alpha training
loss.regularizers: same low adjacency, effective HF energy/DC/low-frequency leakage and fixed normalization for all arms

proposed_future_GPU_budget.sampling: same balanced raw86/110 trace, 400 updates each per arm
proposed_future_GPU_budget.common_prefix: one A200 per reader; branch only declared HF permission and T2 HF seed at B entry
proposed_future_GPU_budget.T2_seed: from same pixel A200, change H initialization only; low field, frozen base, teacher, Adam H zero state, losses and trace unchanged
proposed_future_GPU_budget.smoke: first real GPU short lifecycle with native basis/constant field/CSR CUDA gradients/save-eval-restore-next-stage/persistence; if measured queue is hour-scale, require about10min as project rule
proposed_future_GPU_budget.timing: equal update budget, not equal GPU time; benchmark actual sparse runtime during smoke, no assumed speed-up used as evidence

future_GPU_smoke_gates: actual-scope native feature unit basis and constant-field identity road and joint
finite nonzero teacher-region H texel gradients, no independent ci parameters
geometry/opacity/scale/active unchanged; all five K77266 joint RGB exact
same frozen denominator and teacher binding across all arms
complete checkpoint save/eval/restore/next step/B/C entry including field masks, renderer and sampler
common A fork preserves intended arm gate rather than loading the old mask over it
persistent pixel asset save/reload/requery and native weight refresh at new camera
CPU evidence does not substitute for any native gate

joint K hard gate only; road-only K may contain road hidden behind a kept vehicle, report separately
7A fallback floors and world source-mass gaps remain explicitly counted; no simulated native visibility claims

evaluation.material: A/C/S premult MAE, C/S teacher-qualified edge/detail measures, fixed source and unknown bins; pseudo consistency is not hidden-road GT
evaluation.renderer: clear ideal world-consistent texture and 12/24cm markings; identical cameras/geometry; CPU oracle separate from actual native GPU evidence
evaluation.diagnostic: fixed stripe stencils, cross-view world consistency, read-map failures and aliasing; never hide failed/unsupported pixels
evaluation.acceptance: fit, detail, stripe, A preservation, K and persistence reported separately; no aggregate score hiding tradeoffs
evaluation.historical_reference: previous P independentRGB/.04 controls are historical only; new common bounds/base/scope differ, never label that historical comparison a single-factor causal gain

stop_condition: CPU report/code/data/tests prepared, then stop; no GPU, model inference, scene optimizer, pending controller or power operation
